raw_snippet: In January 2026, we announced a multi-year deal with OpenAI valued at more than $20 billion dollars. OpenAI has agreed to deploy 750 megawatts of Cerebras’s high-speed AI compute
note: OpenAI -> Cerebras take-or-pay committed capacity (750 MW through 2028; option on 1.25 GW more) under the Master Revenue Agreement; counted as a floor ("more than"). The seller is also bound to the buyer: Cerebras gave OpenAI a warrant for 33.4M shares, and OpenAI lent Cerebras $1.0B. Cerebras Form S-1; the January public figure (over $10B) came from press reports only.
